name: Costochondritis
note: Inflammation where the ribs join the breastbone, causing chest-wall pain

name: Sarcoidosis
note: Small patches of inflammation that can affect the lungs, skin and other organs

name: Bronchiolitis
note: A common chest infection in babies and young children

name: Achalasia
note: The food pipe struggles to move food down into the stomach

name: Barrett's oesophagus
note: Changes to the cells lining the food pipe, linked to long-term acid reflux

name: Laryngeal (larynx) cancer
note: Cancer of the voice box

name: Mesothelioma
note: A cancer of the lining of the lungs, usually caused by asbestos

name: Neuroendocrine tumours
note: Rare tumours that grow from hormone-producing cells

name: Complex regional pain syndrome
note: Persistent, severe pain in a limb, usually after an injury

name: Functional neurological disorder
note: Nervous-system symptoms not explained by structural damage

name: Hydrocephalus
note: A build-up of fluid in the brain

name: Postural tachycardia syndrome (PoTS)
note: An abnormal rise in heart rate on standing up

name: Cardiomyopathy
note: Diseases of the heart muscle that make it harder to pump blood

name: Deep vein thrombosis in the arm
note: A blood clot in a deep vein of the arm

name: Hidradenitis suppurativa
note: Painful lumps and abscesses in the skin, often in the armpits and groin

name: Lichen sclerosus
note: Patchy, white, itchy skin, usually around the genitals

name: Alopecia areata
note: Patchy hair loss caused by the immune system

name: Bullous pemphigoid
note: An autoimmune condition causing large, itchy blisters

name: Ehlers-Danlos syndromes
note: Inherited conditions that affect connective tissue and joint flexibility

name: Joint hypermobility syndrome
note: Very flexible joints that cause pain and fatigue

name: Perthes' disease
note: A childhood hip condition affecting the blood supply to the joint

name: Interstitial cystitis
note: Long-term bladder pain and a frequent need to pee, with no infection

name: Polycystic kidney disease
note: An inherited condition where cysts grow in the kidneys

name: IgA nephropathy
note: Kidney damage from a build-up of the antibody IgA

name: Adenomyosis
note: Womb-lining tissue growing into the muscle wall of the womb

name: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)
note: A severe form of premenstrual syndrome

name: Vulvodynia
note: Persistent, unexplained pain in the vulva

name: Klinefelter syndrome
note: A genetic condition where boys are born with an extra X chromosome
